item.q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चुकीचा भाग ओळखा: 'The committee / were divided / in its / opinion.'
item.q_en: Spot the part with an error in the following sentence: 'The committee / were divided / in its / opinion.'
item.e_mr: जेव्हा कमिटीतील सदस्य विभाजित (divided) असतात, तेव्हा अनेकवचनी क्रियापद 'were' आणि सर्वनाम 'their' वापरले जाते. येथे 'its' ऐवजी 'their' यायला हवे होते.
item.o_mr_trans: वाक्य सुधारा: 'The committee were divided in their opinion.'
item.e_en: When a collective noun like 'committee' is divided in opinion, plural verbs and pronouns are used. Therefore, 'its' should be replaced with 'their'.

item.e_mr: योग्य क्रम लावल्यास वाक्य असे बनते: 'Good education (s) builds strong (p) discipline (r) and (q)' किंवा 'Good education (s) builds strong (p) character (q) and discipline (r)' -> योग्य क्रम s - p - q - r आहे. (Good education builds strong character and discipline).
